## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / maintenance

## Verification

- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit`

- [ ] Build checked when applicable

## Data and configuration

- [ ] No database migration required

## Notes for reviewer

List risks, limitations, and anything that needs special review.
